# Completion Report: Work Order 4 — PreToolUse Gates

1. **PreToolUse Handler** ([`pretooluse.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/harness/antigravity/pretooluse.go))
